variable_coverage.construction: XRET_(t+1)=∏_(12 months)(1+firm monthly raw cum-dividend RET)−∏_(12 months)(1+matched Size–BVE/MVE portfolio monthly RET). Firm returns run from month 5 of fiscal year t+1 through month 4 of t+2; portfolio returns are value-weighted monthly returns constructed on July–June periods. Keep the two source windows distinct until their assignment is resolved.

GΔRDA_(t+1) is the within-year five-group rank (0–4 divided by 4) of ΔRDA, sorted descending so the rank falls as ΔRDA rises. ΔRDA is the source-retained change in five-year-capitalized RDASSET from t to t+1 divided by NOA; the denominator year is not specified.

GRDA_t is the within-year five-group rank of RDA_t, divided by four and increasing in RDA. RDASSET_t uses RDEXP_t through t−4; RDA_t divides by MVE at the end of the fourth month following fiscal-year-end t, computed from security price and shares.

GARNOA_(t+1) is the within-year five-group rank of adjusted return on net operating assets. Adjusted earnings add reported R&D expense and subtract RDAMORT; RDAMORT_s=0.2×Σ_(j=1..5)RDEXP_(s−j). Adjusted NOA adds the five-year RDASSET to reported NOA. The denominator year is contradictory: Table 8 says t+1; Appendix note 17 says t.

Construct the five-year R&D asset/amortization; rank within year using five groups and preserve the direction GΔRDA decreasing, GRDA/GARNOA increasing. Main sample, R&D subset and benchmark universe are distinct.

No regression weights are reported. Separately, the expected-return control portfolios use value-weighted monthly returns; those portfolio weights are part of XRET construction, not weights in Equation (1).

For GARNOA_(t+1), Table 8 says adjusted NOA for year t+1 while Appendix footnote 17 says adjusted NOA for year t. This denominator date changes the ranked predictor and remains unresolved.

The paper defines firm XRET for months 5 of fiscal year t+1 through month 4 of t+2, but portfolio controls are described as July–June. The source does not explicitly reconcile the two calendar windows for Equation (1).

Recreate 25 annually formed value-weighted Size–BVE/MVE portfolio returns using prior-calendar-year equity/book values, net imputed R&D assets, NYSE June 30 breakpoints and the delisting substitution rule.
The paper uses Compustat PST/full-coverage/merged-research annual databases and period-specific CRSP data; local Compustat and CRSP are current vintages.
